title: Wren and the Orchard
author: Noor Hartwell
blurb: Isandro Quintana, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
